title: Marines and Sailors conduct a ground refuel on an MQ-8C Fire Scout.
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Heavy Helicopter Squadron (HMH) 361, Marine Aircraft Group 16, 3rd Marine Aircraft Wing, and U.S. Navy Sailors assigned to Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 21 from Naval Air Station North Island, San Diego, California, conduct a ground refuel for an MQ-8C Fire Scout during Service Level Training Exercise (SLTE) 5-23, at Camp Wilson, Marine Corps Air-Ground Combat Center, Twentynine Palms, California, July 31, 2023. SLTE is a series of exercises meant to prepare the MAGTF for quick and effective responses to military operations, where the MQ-8C has shown its capabilities of operating from ship to shore with a mobile control station and the ability to refuel from any location in support of the Marine Corps' mission. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Richard PerezGarcia)
unit_name: Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center
